original_value: Compact USB-C flash storage cartridge designed for document transfer, firmware loading, and field data capture. The Nimbus uses a retractable connector, a matte polycarbonate shell, and a low-power controller tuned for everyday portability rather than gaming or high-end throughput. It includes basic wear-leveling, LED activity indication, and cross-platform plug-and-play support for modern laptops, tablets, and handheld devices.
